# Legacy R32 compatibility fixture (tests only)

These five compiled JavaScript files are unmodified, byte-for-byte copies of the 2026-10-03 R32 release's TaskJournal and records relative import closure. Only automated backward-compatibility tests import them; they are not part of the published npm package. File hashes are retained in the RC2 evidence/fixture-manifest.json. Do not use them as production code or for owner approvals.
